notes.title: Update V0.2.0 - Tides of Change
notes.content:
Introducing: Runes[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44806523/e542040fdb04fa0fa6c1518080fd31595d14e7a5.png"]
Runes are your quintessential run modifiers.

From double boss fights to flipped item rarities, these runes will encourage new playstyle and give you some additional gameplay variety!

Runes are unlocked through achievements, similarly to weapons.

They are all unlocked relatively easily to keep them accessible, so just play a little and you'll get them with no problem 🙂

Hope they spice up your runs!

Weapons: Dagger, Guardian's Bulwark & Eye Of The Abyss


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44806523/26332154a2f8dd4b8bd73a4ed9a2e3a7ddb1ac51.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44806523/745fb90c88d169b8a51669c059abee33b42320f9.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44806523/d4088a92b84e2445a75955a0cd13f611451f15b6.png"]



Here are some new weapon types we're introducing. To differentiate the new weapons from the existing ones, the direction we've taken was to design new and interesting gimmicks for these new weapons, which we hope would offer new and interesting playstyles for you to enjoy!

Balance changes:Weapon Reworks: Molten Sickle & Blighted Trident
We've been wanting to rework these for a while now as they felt rather weak or outdated compared to more recent weapons and to compensate for the status effect damage nerf in an earlier patch.

Here are the changes:
Molten sickle:
• Slightly changed the timing of sickle's attacks.

• Strengthened the ability, ability now inflicts overheat, and explosion damage has been increased.
Blighted Trident:
• Attacks now have a chance to poison

• Poison duration from the ability has been increased.


Item Updates:
• Lucid bastion hp & damage has been reduced

• Tidepiercer damage has been reduced


Bug Fixes:
• Generation: Generation has been fully fixed, this means no more floating altars, no more wrongly placed chests, no more missing stuff, everything is exactly where it should be.

• Molten sickle: Previously the explosion did no damage

• Blobber's first trait, Septic Shock, was previously shooting 50x the number of projectiles it was supposed to, causing an immense amount of lag. This has been resolved.

• Deathscreen previously may have missing stats display.

• Fixed an issue where the player could not access the Boss Rush after finishing a run in the lobby tutorial.

• Magma eye's projectile now shoots correctly


Small Changes:
• Perforator did not have a boss icon, this has been fixed.

• Starting Boss Rush fight now removes all active dropped items off the map.

• Some enemies gain hyperarmour while doing charge attacks

notes.title: Update 0.1.70a – Balance Changes & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
v0.1.70a Patch Notes

Bug Fixes:

 Fixed an issue where the "Damage" and "Damage Taken" stats were not being registered.
 Fixed an issue where item unlocks failed to sync with achievements, causing some items to be incorrectly unobtainable.
 Fixed an issue where Charon's Obol failed to spawn projectiles after a certain amount of usage.
 Fixed an issue where resolution adjustments made through the pause menu were not being applied.
 Fixed an issue where, under certain circumstances, Sea Angel became invulnerable.
 Fixed an issue where the Seafarer's Compass indicator did not disappear.


Balance Changes:

 Abyssal Valor's cooldown has been increased.
 Damage from Poison and Overheat has been reduced.
 Drop rates for legendary items have been adjusted.
 Charon's Obol hitbox has been increased.
 Health pools for some bosses have been adjusted.
 Health and damage values for some enemies have been adjusted.
 Currency drop amounts from enemies have been adjusted.
 EXP requirements for level-ups have been adjusted.
 Unwanted Sentience's range and projectile count have been reduced.
 I-frames during dashes have been adjusted.


Quality of Life:

 Added an option to press ESC to return to the main menu from the lobby.


The first batch of balance changes is finally out!
We'll be closely listening to your feedback on these changes to continuously improve your player experience : )

Don’t forget to join our Discord and let us know what you think!

notes.title: Your Tutorial Issues have been addressed! (We are so sorry! >.
notes.content:
Hey Divers!

Please give us another chance!
There were many concerns raised in regards with the Tutorial stopping players from progressing at the start, and we hear you! The team has now addressed these issues and the tutorial should be able to progress smoothly into the game now.

Here's a fix to the Tutorial bug:
A simple restart should solve the problem, but if it still doesn't work, please try the following: delete the file located at [AppData > LocalLow > Starpixel > Dive The Depths > lobbyEvents.json.]

Another alternate solution is this [Right-click on your game in Steam > Properties > Installed Files > Verify Integrity of Game Files]

Thank you to all the feedback that has been raised so far. We really appreciate all of your support! 

If you encounter any other problems we really appreciate if you could send them in our Discord right now to directly report to the team! Especially when you encounter major bugs (eg. Can't damage enemies, game crashed, parts of map are missing, etc) - it would be helpful clip the moment as well as to send in the player logs in the discord!


From,
The Dive the Depths team

notes.title: Dive The Depths Joins Steam Next Fest. Demo Now Available
notes.content:
Hello Divers,  

We’re excited to share that Dive The Depths is part of Steam Next Fest. Our demo is now live, offering you a chance to explore the underwater world we’ve been building. It’s been a labor of love to craft this action-roguelike adventure, and we’re eager to see you dive in and tackle its challenges firsthand.

What’s in the Demo

 A slice of our submerged environments, from eerie ruins to vibrant biomes.  
 Encounters with unique sea creatures and a taste of our boss battles.  
 A glimpse into the progression system, with treasures and upgrades to uncover.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3248400/Dive_The_Depths_Demo/

We’ve designed this demo to give you a solid feel for the game, and we’d love to hear your thoughts as we polish the full experience.

Release Date Announcement

We’ve also recently revealed the official release date for Dive The Depths with a new trailer. Take a look below to see what awaits when the game launches. It’s a peek at the depths we’ve been shaping for you.

[previewyoutube=dmmtC14tfZk;full][/previewyoutube]
Steam Next Fest runs through March 3, giving you a full week to try the demo. We’d appreciate your feedback in the Community Hub or on our Discord. 

It helps us refine the game ahead of release. If you enjoy what you play, please consider adding Dive The Depths to your wishlist on the Steam page. It’s a big boost for us and keeps you updated on our progress.

We’re thrilled to bring this underwater journey to you during Next Fest. The ocean’s depths are unforgiving, but they’re also packed with wonders.

We hope you’ll find it worth exploring. Looking forward to hearing from you!
